@@ -1,36 +0,0 @@
-name: Enable Worker Split v2
-
-on:
-  workflow_dispatch:
-    inputs:
-      confirm:
-        description: "Type enable to run Phase C worker split v2 on prod"
-        required: true
-        default: ""
-  push:
-    branches:
-      - ops/trigger-enable-worker-v2
-
-jobs:
-  enable-v2:
-    name: Enable worker split v2
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.inputs.confirm == 'enable'
-    concurrency: deploy-group
-    steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
-      - uses: superfly/flyctl-actions/setup-flyctl@master
-        with:
-          version: latest
-      - name: Run Phase C enablement
-        run: |
-          chmod +x scripts/fly_enable_worker_v2.sh scripts/fly_worker_split_v2_guard.sh
-          ./scripts/fly_enable_worker_v2.sh
-        env:
-          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
-          FLY_PRIMARY_REGION: sjc
-      - name: Babysit Phase C
-        run: |
-          chmod +x scripts/babysit_phase.sh
-          BASE=https://subnet-dashboard.fly.dev ./scripts/babysit_phase.sh c || true
-        continue-on-error: true

+**v2:** opt-in only via `scripts/fly_enable_worker_v2.sh`  
 **Rollback:** `scripts/fly_disable_worker_v2.sh` · `split-v2-rollback-runbook.md`
